note: RV park at Treasure Island Resort & Casino near Welch: a paved grid of full-hookup pads (88 of them pull-throughs) beside the casino parking, with a free shuttle to the casino. The River's Edge sites, without hookups, sit about 700 m away by the beach and marina on the Mississippi. --Claude

flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google rule): Google Maps 'Treasure Island Resort & Casino RV Park' 3.8 stars with 115 reviews: under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

Casino-lot question (reviewer decides): on the operator map and Esri imagery the 94 hookup pads are a paved grid of rows A-N (~44.6300-44.6332, -92.6467 to -92.6457) directly beside the casino's car park, plus a gravel 'RV DRY LOT (self-contained rigs)'. It has hookups, a bathhouse, laundry, an office and Campspot booking, so it is a dedicated RV park rather than an overnight-parking lot, which is how inclusion_evidence reads it; flagged only because the curation doc excludes casino-lot parks.

WATERFRONT LEAD (unresolved): the operator page says River's Edge 'Sites 30-38: Waterfront view' and River's Edge sites are 'located near our beach and Treasure Island Marina. No hookups available.'; they are listed under RV SITES as well as tent sites, and Campspot sells a 'River's Edge - Waterfront' type a 23-ft rig fits (fees note). Esri imagery around the marina (~44.6365,-92.6430) predates the River's Edge loop, so the sites can't be placed or measured; on the map they run beside the beach south of the Paradise Cove pavilion (~44.6360,-92.6420). Needs Campspot site photos or newer imagery before any change from 'not waterfront'. The hookup pads themselves are ~700 m from the water (not waterfront correct for them).
Split note: River's Edge is ~700 m from the main RV park on its own road ('ROAD TO RIVER'S EDGE CAMPSITES'), under the ~1 km split threshold; one entry is fine.

Long-stay: seasonal sites are sold ('join us for a full season of summer nights'; seasonal leases with a $500 deposit) but nights are the headline product (Campspot, concert-night stays). No seasonal share posted; imagery shows the grid busy with RVs without skirting or decks, consistent with transient use.
Fees and season not on the operator pages; the stored Campspot-derived fees (read 2026-10-13) and season 04-01 to 11-01 (derived) are left as they are.
Phone 651-267-3060 and website lines confirmed. Pin 44.63150,-92.64700 is on the hookup grid; no move.
